# protocols.io

> > Open-access repository of scientific protocols spanning molecular biology, CRISPR techniques, immunoprecipitation, and behavioral assays from research institutions worldwide.

protocols.io hosts detailed laboratory protocols contributed by researchers from institutions including UC Berkeley IGI, Brigham Young University, ETH Zurich, and Imperial College London. Protocols cover molecular biology fundamentals, advanced gene editing techniques, protein analysis, and experimental methods, all shared under Creative Commons licensing.

## Key Topics

- molecular biology
- CRISPR guide RNA
- in vitro transcription
- bacterial transformation
- gel electrophoresis
- restriction digest
- DNA ligation
- immunoprecipitation
- SDS-PAGE
- primer design
- T7 transcription
- fluorescent protein calibration
- UC Berkeley IGI
- Christensen Lab
- Creative Commons Attribution License

## Molecular Biology Fundamentals

- [Basic Molecular Biology](https://www.protocols.io/view/basic-molecular-biology-bc64izgw.html): Molecular biology protocol collection from Christensen Lab at BYU

## CRISPR and Gene Editing

- [In vitro transcription of guide RNAs and 5'-triphosphate removal](https://www.protocols.io/view/in-vitro-transcription-of-guide-rnas-and-5-triphos-bfxfjpjn.html): CRISPR guide RNA transcription protocol from UC Berkeley IGI

## Protein Analysis and Assays

- [Immunoprecipitation assays(about S100A6 in SW480 Cells)](https://www.protocols.io/view/immunoprecipitation-assays-about-s100a6-in-sw480-c-mqdc5s6.html): S100A6 immunoprecipitation protocol for SW480 colon cancer cells
- [FPCount protocol - Short protocol](https://www.protocols.io/view/fpcount-protocol-short-protocol-bzt6p6re.html): Fluorescent protein calibration protocol from Imperial College London

## Behavioral and Specialized Protocols

- [Active Avoidance protocol 01282020](https://www.protocols.io/view/active-avoidance-protocol-01282020-bbu6inze.html): Active avoidance behavioral protocol for traumatic brain injury studies
